verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly describe agentic workflows for tracing codebases, scoping and planning changes, reproducing/fixing bugs, and inspecting diffs/checks before merge — directly matching the story of describing a feature/bug and having the agent implement or fix it across files (cursor-docs-1 through 4, 11, 12). Community evidence corroborates this is a real, heavily-used capability (used daily despite complaints), though it also surfaces reliability gripes not specific to multi-file editing. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks specifically verifying multi-file edit accuracy/success rate, and no concrete counter-example of the agent failing this exact task.
